title: 09 The Shadow Figure · 小小的黑影

sents.t: Two friends are inside a room recording someone who appears to be yelling at something.
sents.zh: 两个朋友在一个房间里，正在拍一个好像在对着什么东西大喊的人。

sents.t: It isn't until they decide to approach this person that they see what it is that they're yelling at.
sents.zh: 直到他们走近这个人，才看清他在对着什么喊。

sents.t: What they saw left them more disturbed than before.
sents.zh: 他们看到的东西让他们比之前更加不安。

sents.t: There appears to be a small, shadowy figure manifesting and disappearing at the same time.
sents.zh: 画面里似乎有一个小小的黑影，忽隐忽现。

sents.t: I'll leave it to you to decide as to whether or not this was something paranormal.
sents.zh: 这是不是灵异现象，就交给你来判断。

sents.t: As always, what are your thoughts?
